drivers/nvmem/sprd-efuse.c.note: UMS9632 read-only normal bank; programming functions removed; bounded multiword reads

drivers/watchdog/sprd_wdt.c.note: Register/bit/key/counter layout compared; U30Pro alias and native watchdog-core takeover; no Android hang-debug feeder

include/linux/regmap.h.note: Native bounded MMIO SET/CLR backend for UMS9632 glbregs; replaces Android regmap hook

drivers/base/regmap/regmap-mmio.c.note: Native bounded MMIO SET/CLR backend for UMS9632 glbregs; replaces Android regmap hook

drivers/mfd/syscon.c.note: Native bounded MMIO SET/CLR backend for UMS9632 glbregs; replaces Android regmap hook

drivers/mmc/host/sdhci-sprd.c.note: R11P3 temporary 52 MHz read-only enumeration on upstream driver, no CQE/ICE/high-speed tuning/FFU, runtime suspend held off; the SDIO-only R11P3 host (no-sd, no-mmc: AIC8800 Wi-Fi) has a run-time bus mode (sdio_mode 0 high speed default, 1 SDR50, 2 SDR104, 3 DDR50; sdio_max_hz) and the PHY DLL in the UHS-I modes; SDR104 tuning of that host by a PHY DLL sweep as in the vendor's sdhci-sprd-tuning.c

drivers/mmc/core/sdio.c.note: A failed UHS-I initialization (tuning) retries at high speed and turns UHS-I off for the host until the next boot, instead of losing the card
